_oracles_note: Further INDEPENDENT oracles, quoted for m-of-n loans, e.g. ["http://127.0.0.1:8742", "http://127.0.0.1:8743"]. Each must run from its own keyfile, or a 2-of-3 is really a 1-of-1. They never stand in for the primary: a vault verifies against the key baked into it.
_poll_note: Seconds between chain and oracle refreshes; keep it under block_seconds.
_age_note: A verified attestation older than max_price_age seconds is not a price: health, LTV and liquidatable are withheld rather than computed from it, and /healthz turns unhealthy.
_depth_note: min_depth is how deep a funding must be before a loan reads as LIVE. rescan_depth is how far back a poll may walk for a spend it missed, and back_scan_cap how many blocks one poll may fetch for those walks; a book down longer than rescan_depth needs one start with --rescan-from <height>.
_prune_note: How long a FINISHED record is kept: a spent offer, a closed vault, an ended cross-chain take. The chain is the record and this book is an index of it, so nothing pruned is lost -- but every list is rendered end to end on every read, and a record nothing can happen to any more pays that for ever. Anything still open is kept whatever its age; 0 keeps everything.
_proxies_note: Peers whose X-Forwarded-For this daemon believes, which is how the write rate limit is keyed per client behind Caddy. pignusd must not be reachable except through the proxy.
_rpc_note: Optional. Without it the book still serves offers and whatever it last knew, and says so in /healthz rather than presenting stale states as fresh. Fill in ONE of cookie or user/password.
_btc_rpc_note: Optional, and only for cross-chain loans. The book reads the parent chain's tip through it so a Bitcoin-side deadline is checked against a height this daemon read itself rather than one a client sent. It never spends: no wallet is needed.
